text:
alex.ng: Hey team — urgent: Shoply reporting rerank endpoint 502/504s under load. p95 token latency jumped from ~180ms to ~1.8s, clients seeing gateway timeouts and heavy retries. Any immediate ideas?

sre-bot: Alert: rerank-prod cluster-4 p95 latency 1800ms, 502/504 count=120 in last 5m, error-rate=4.2% (auto-throttle triggered).

maria.s: @alex.ng can you paste a sample request + customer burst pattern? Which model variant and region?

alex.ng: sample payload (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"..."},...]}'
```
Customer load: bursts ~600 req/s for short windows, batches up to 128 candidates. Model: rdx-rank-v2-quant on us-west-2. First spike observed ~10:12 UTC.

jason.k: 600 qps + batch=128 = a lot of token churn. Could be queueing + KV cache thrash. Are we seeing 504 (gateway timeout) or 502 (upstream reset)? 504 -> backend slow, 502 -> crash.

alex.ng: Mostly 504 and connection resets from the gateway. Backend logs show some 5xx and a few container restarts around same times.

maria.s: Repro steps: run a synthetic replay against staging with same concurrency/batch to confirm. Example: 
```
wrk -t12 -c200 -d60s -s scripts/rerank.lua -- http://staging-internal/rerank - <body.json>
```
I'll also pull dmesg, container restart counts, and GPU memory/cgroup stats.

ops-bot: Deployment event: autoscaler adjusted pool size +2 for rerank-prod-4 at 2026-11-03T09:58:12Z.

jason.k: Short-term mitigations: lower max_batch_size to 64 for the affected shard, enforce per-tenant concurrency limit (e.g., 50) for Shoply, and enable a circuit-breaker to return 503 quickly when workers saturate to avoid retry storms.

alex.ng: Can gateway add Retry-After header and simple token bucket enforcement per API key? Right now customers retry aggressively which amplifies the spike.

jason.k: Yes — set moderate Retry-After and 429/503 behavior. Also consider temporary IP/tenant rate-limits until autoscaler stabilizes.

maria.s: I ran the staging repro: with 600 qps and batch=128 we reproduced p95>1.6s and saw 2 worker restarts (OOM-like). Root cause looks like memory pressure from large batches + KV cache eviction thrash; memory spikes lead to process restarts and then 5xx cascades.

alex.ng: Plan proposal: 1) reduce default max_batch_size to 64, 2) bump memory limit for ranker pods on prod-4, 3) add gateway backpressure (drop/queue early), 4) enable hot-kv pinning for frequent prefixes. Can we canary tonight?

jason.k: I'll prepare helm value overrides and a canary rollout to shard=4 tonight. Runbook draft coming: 
```
# quick restart to apply memory bump
kubectl -n prod set resources deploy/ranker --limits=memory=20Gi --selector=shard=4
kubectl rollout restart deploy/ranker -l shard=4
```

liz: Escalating to Enterprise Support & Account team for Shoply. I'll draft a customer message offering a short-term rate-limit and ETA for mitigation. Also request postmortem once stabilized.

maria.s: After canary we should monitor: p95 latency, 5xx rate, restart counts, KV cache hit ratio, and gateway queue length. Metrics dashboard updated and alert thresholds lowered for this flow.

sre-bot: Incident suppression toggled; deployment patch rolled to shard-4 at 11:37 UTC. Alerts quieted. Postmortem required — assign owner in #postmortems.

alex.ng: Thanks — please add the customer-facing template to #support-ops and assign follow-ups. I'll coordinate the canary window with oncall. :thumbsup:
